concepts/web-calls.description: Understand Nixflex website voice, the Web agent switches, public visitor context and restricted actions before enabling browser calls on your website.

advanced/webhooks.title: Verify and process webhook events in code
advanced/webhooks.description: Verify raw-body signatures, save events durably, deduplicate booking results and reconcile missed deliveries through authenticated call reads.

guides/developer/webhooks/event-types.title: Choose webhook events for your integration
guides/developer/webhooks/event-types.description: Choose call, booking and SMS events by what they prove, and keep pre-call callbacks, custom functions and unsigned reachability tests separate.

guides/developer/webhooks/delivery-and-r.title: Recover delayed or repeated webhook deliveries
guides/developer/webhooks/delivery-and-r.description: Handle webhook timing, retries, duplicates and missed events with durable acceptance and authenticated reads instead of repeating calls or bookings.

integrations/overview.title: Choose an integration workflow
integrations/overview.description: Choose Nixflex calendar, notification, custom-function and pre-call integrations, understand their scope and verify outcomes across calls and business systems.

advanced/custom-functions.title: Connect an agent to your business API
advanced/custom-functions.description: Connect Nixflex to a custom HTTPS function, verify signed requests, enforce business permissions and handle timeouts without repeating uncertain actions.

advanced/precall-gate.title: Provide context before an inbound call
advanced/precall-gate.description: Configure a Nixflex inbound pre-call hook, verify its request and return caller context or an explicit refusal within the fail-open timing budget.

integrations/slack.title: Send call results to Slack
integrations/slack.description: Configure Nixflex Slack notifications for the intended number, protect the destination and distinguish a saved connection from successful notification delivery.

integrations/gohighlevel.title: Connect call results to GoHighLevel
integrations/gohighlevel.description: Configure Nixflex GoHighLevel for the correct business number, protect credentials and verify external records before treating an automation as complete.

integrations/zapier-make.title: Build event automations with Zapier or Make
integrations/zapier-make.description: Connect Nixflex events to Zapier or Make, use the intended number-level destination and build duplicate handling around actual event and action outcomes.

guides/developer/bring-your-own.title: Connect your own model, voice or storage
guides/developer/bring-your-own.description: Choose the supported Nixflex bring-your-own connection, keep credentials private and test fallback, scope and data lifecycle separately.

advanced/your-own-llm.title: Connect a compatible model account
advanced/your-own-llm.description: Configure a compatible model connection for Nixflex, keep credentials private and understand verification, fallback and the boundaries of account-wide settings.

advanced/your-own-tts.title: Use a voice from your own provider account
advanced/your-own-tts.description: Read a Nixflex custom voice connection, test speaking behaviour and understand account scope, fallback and credential changes before using it on calls.

advanced/your-own-storage.title: Store recordings in your own bucket
advanced/your-own-storage.description: Connect Nixflex recordings to an S3-compatible bucket, verify access and handle storage fallback while managing your own object access and retention policies.

guides/developer/organisations.title: Build team administration in code
guides/developer/organisations.description: Read Nixflex organisation context, manage team invitations and permitted roles, and separate shared-key authority from personal login and ownership actions.

guides/developer/team/invitations-and-ro.title: Manage team invitations and role changes
guides/developer/team/invitations-and-ro.description: Build team administration with personal role checks, invitation expiry and seat limits, while preserving unknown invitation and removal outcomes.

guides/developer/team/ownership-and-clos.title: Handle ownership changes and account closure
guides/developer/team/ownership-and-clos.description: Keep ownership acceptance, leaving and account closure in the authenticated personal flow, and reconcile access, key handling and unfinished work.

concepts/organisations.title: Understand organisation roles and credentials
concepts/organisations.description: Understand Nixflex accounts, team roles, invitations, billing access and ownership, while keeping personal logins separate from the shared API credential.

guides/developer/account.title: Manage account behaviour in your integration
guides/developer/account.description: Find Nixflex account guides for usage, retention, authentication boundaries, request limits, error recovery and Owner-only closure.

guides/developer/billing.title: Read usage and plan call capacity
guides/developer/billing.description: Read Nixflex usage and call capacity, interpret optional reservation fields and separate account counters from invoices and external telephone charges.

concepts/data-retention.title: Understand retention and saved copies
concepts/data-retention.description: Understand Nixflex call and message retention, new-agent defaults, delayed cleanup and customer storage before choosing how long your records are kept.

guides/developer/account/security.title: Separate login security and API authority
guides/developer/account/security.description: Keep Nixflex personal sessions, two-factor authentication and organisation API keys separate when designing access to your application.

guides/developer/account/closure.title: Handle organisation closure in your app
guides/developer/account/closure.description: Design around Owner-only dashboard closure, locked access and retained financial evidence without confusing closure with content deletion.

guides/developer/logs.title: Trace API requests and webhook deliveries
guides/developer/logs.description: Use request IDs and dashboard metadata to investigate Nixflex API failures and delivery attempts without logging secrets or replaying uncertain writes.

guides/developer/errors.title: Handle API errors in code
guides/developer/errors.description: Handle Nixflex error codes, keep unknown write outcomes visible and reconcile calls, messages and number changes before retrying work.

guides/developer/pagination.title: Build reliable paginated API reads
guides/developer/pagination.description: Read Nixflex cursor and offset lists without changing their filters, losing message ties or treating an offset scan as a stable snapshot.

guides/developer/rate-limits.title: Pace API requests and polling
guides/developer/rate-limits.description: Use Nixflex rate-limit headers to pace reads and polling. Keep HTTP request quotas separate from call concurrency, balance and knowledge limits.

guides/developer/idempotency.title: Prevent duplicate work in code
guides/developer/idempotency.description: Save outbound call UUIDs and Knowledge operation keys correctly, keep their account and environment binding, and reconcile other uncertain writes.

guides/developer/build-with-ai.title: Build your app or SaaS with AI
guides/developer/build-with-ai.description: Build a Nixflex-powered app with an AI coding assistant, server-side credentials, explicit customer isolation and verified call or booking results.

guides/developer/switch-to-nixflex.title: Switch from Retell or Vapi to Nixflex
guides/developer/switch-to-nixflex.description: Map an existing Retell or Vapi integration to Nixflex, rebuild the contract boundaries and test routing, actions and results before a controlled cutover.

guides/developer/reference.title: Find Nixflex definitions and reference help
guides/developer/reference.description: Find the shared Nixflex FAQ, pricing explanation and glossary, plus the exact API errors and rate-limit reference.

reference/faq.title: Find answers about setup, bookings and billing
reference/faq.description: Find clear answers about Nixflex numbers, agents, calendars, website conversations, charges and recording access, with links to the current guides.

reference/pricing.title: Check standard rates and separate service charges
reference/pricing.description: Understand standard Nixflex rates, separate telephone charges, shared credit and recording storage without assuming delivery or deletion is guaranteed.

guides/glossary.title: Understand the words used in Nixflex
guides/glossary.description: Learn the words used across Nixflex guides and the dashboard, including agent, phone number, knowledge, topic, source, campaign and team roles.

reference/errors.title: Debug failed requests safely
reference/errors.description: Investigate Nixflex API failures using safe request identifiers and machine codes, while preserving unknown write outcomes and non-JSON errors.

reference/rate-limits.title: Understand API quotas and call capacity
reference/rate-limits.description: Separate Nixflex HTTP request allowances, concurrent calls, messaging capacity and Knowledge limits, then handle each refusal using its actual result.

api-reference/introduction.title: Use the Nixflex API
api-reference/introduction.description: Explore the Nixflex API for voice agents, calls, numbers, SMS and knowledge. Find authentication, request fields, response shapes and examples.

api-reference/authentication.title: Authenticate API requests
api-reference/authentication.description: Authenticate Nixflex API requests with a server-side key. Understand account ownership, personal sessions and Owner, Admin and Member permissions.

api-reference/errors.title: Handle API errors
api-reference/errors.description: Find Nixflex API error codes, HTTP statuses and recovery steps. Distinguish invalid input, permission failures, temporary errors and uncertain results.

api-reference/pagination.title: Page through API results
api-reference/pagination.description: Page through Nixflex agents, calls, numbers and knowledge. Use each endpoint’s limit, offset or cursor without losing filters or assuming one list shape.

api-reference/rate-limits.title: Handle API rate limits
api-reference/rate-limits.description: Handle Nixflex API rate limits using RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and Retry-After. Keep request quotas separate from call capacity and feature limits.

api-reference/idempotency.title: Reuse supported operation identities
api-reference/idempotency.description: Use Nixflex knowledge operation keys and revisions correctly. Learn which requests support replay and how to handle uncertain calls, SMS and other writes.

api-reference/retries.title: Retry failed API requests
api-reference/retries.description: Choose safe retry behavior for Nixflex API reads and writes. Honor Retry-After, reconcile unknown outcomes and avoid duplicate calls, messages or purchases.

api-reference/versioning.title: Track API versions and compatibility
api-reference/versioning.description: Track Nixflex API compatibility, additive fields and retired routes. Preserve unknown values and confirm client support before changing a live integration.

api-reference/webhooks.title: Receive and verify webhook events
api-reference/webhooks.description: Receive Nixflex call and booking events. Verify raw-body signatures, handle duplicate delivery and fetch private recording links when playback is needed.

api-reference/call-bookings.title: Receive booking results: call.bookings
api-reference/call-bookings.description: Receive confirmed Nixflex booking actions and their final results after a call. Verify signatures, count active bookings and handle duplicate deliveries.

api-reference/agents/contract.title: Understand agent settings and defaults
api-reference/agents/contract.description: Understand Nixflex agent fields, defaults, limits and nullable values. Configure call behavior, prompts, keyterms, retention and supported channel settings.

api-reference/agents/create.title: Create an agent
api-reference/agents/create.description: Create an agent and receive its agent_id for later reads, updates and calls. A successful create does not assign a phone number or start a call.

api-reference/agents/list.title: List agents
api-reference/agents/list.description: List Nixflex agents owned by the account. Read their settings and use each agent ID for detail, update or disable requests.

api-reference/agents/get.title: Get an agent
api-reference/agents/get.description: Read one Nixflex agent and its saved settings. Check whether it is active before assigning numbers or starting calls.

api-reference/agents/update.title: Update an agent
api-reference/agents/update.description: Update selected settings on an owned Nixflex agent. The PUT request is partial: omitted fields keep their saved values.

api-reference/agents/delete.title: Disable an agent
api-reference/agents/delete.description: Disable an owned Nixflex agent. Understand the inactive state, retained record and checks before assigning numbers or starting calls.

api-reference/phone-numbers/list.title: List phone numbers
api-reference/phone-numbers/list.description: List phone numbers owned by the Nixflex account. Read assigned agents and saved number settings before routing or configuration changes.

api-reference/phone-numbers/get.title: Get a phone number
api-reference/phone-numbers/get.description: Read one owned Nixflex phone number, its assigned agent and saved settings. Use the encoded international number in the request path.

api-reference/phone-numbers/import.title: Import a phone number
api-reference/phone-numbers/import.description: Import a phone number you own into Nixflex and assign it to an active agent. Review existing routing before changing the number configuration.

api-reference/phone-numbers/update.title: Update a phone number
api-reference/phone-numbers/update.description: Update an owned Nixflex number's settings or move it to another active agent on the account. Review routing and uncertain outcomes before retrying.

api-reference/phone-numbers/usage.title: Get number usage
api-reference/phone-numbers/usage.description: Read usage for an owned Nixflex phone number. Check the response fields and account scope before using the totals in your application.

api-reference/phone-numbers/credentials.title: Update phone number credentials
api-reference/phone-numbers/credentials.description: Update carrier credentials for an imported Nixflex phone number in place. Preserve settings and handle uncertain routing or credential saves safely.

api-reference/phone-numbers/delete.title: Remove a phone number
api-reference/phone-numbers/delete.description: Disconnect an owned number from Nixflex and clear routing managed by its import. This does not release the number from your carrier account.

api-reference/calls/list.title: List calls
api-reference/calls/list.description: Read the legacy call list as a bare array, newest creation time first. Use the documented filters and page limits.

api-reference/calls/get-calls-history.title: Get call history
api-reference/calls/get-calls-history.description: Read a filtered call-history envelope with matching totals. History includes failed starts and omits transcripts, event data, extracted data and recording URLs.

api-reference/calls/get.title: Get a call
api-reference/calls/get.description: Read one account-owned call. Call completion is separate from recording, analysis and booking finalisation.

api-reference/calls/get-bookings.title: Read call booking results
api-reference/calls/get-bookings.description: Read confirmed booking results for a Nixflex call. Distinguish ready, none, processing, deleted and unavailable without guessing from a transcript.

api-reference/calls/get-calls-id-recordi.title: Get a call recording
api-reference/calls/get-calls-id-recordi.description: Read Nixflex call recording status and obtain a fresh signed download link when available. Handle unavailable, pending and deleted recordings.

api-reference/calls/create-outbound.title: Create an outbound call
api-reference/calls/create-outbound.description: Start an outbound call with an optional saved UUID. Reconcile replayed, pending and unknown requests without automatically placing another call.

api-reference/calls/get-outbound-request.title: Read an outbound call request
api-reference/calls/get-outbound-request.description: Check a Nixflex outbound request by its saved UUID. Keep pending and unknown outcomes distinct and avoid starting a duplicate call.

api-reference/calls/client-safety.title: Handle call outcomes and safe retries
api-reference/calls/client-safety.description: Handle Nixflex call starts, active calls, deletions and unknown outcomes. Use confirmed state before retrying actions or treating a call as completed.

api-reference/calls/delete.title: Delete a call
api-reference/calls/delete.description: Hang up and delete an owned call, track recording cleanup and safely resume queued deletion while retaining used charges.

api-reference/calls/delete-all.title: Delete all calls
api-reference/calls/delete-all.description: Request guarded deletion of Nixflex call data for the account. Review scope, cleanup requirements and uncertain outcomes before another request.

api-reference/voice-campaigns/get-campai.title: List voice campaigns
api-reference/voice-campaigns/get-campai.description: List this account’s voice campaigns, newest first. This bounded list has no offset or cursor.

api-reference/calls/batch-create.title: Create a voice campaign
api-reference/calls/batch-create.description: Create a Nixflex voice campaign and its recipients. Default now mode requests launch immediately; use schedule mode to prepare a later launch.

api-reference/calls/batch-launch.title: Launch a voice campaign
api-reference/calls/batch-launch.description: Request the first launch of an owned Nixflex voice campaign. Check readiness, consent and launch state before dispatching calls.

api-reference/voice-campaigns/post-calls.title: Cancel voice campaign
api-reference/voice-campaigns/post-calls.description: Cancel future work for an owned voice campaign. Calls or messages already in progress may finish.

api-reference/voice-campaigns/post-calls.title: Resume voice campaign
api-reference/voice-campaigns/post-calls.description: Resume a bounded page of verified, unattempted recipients in a running Nixflex voice campaign. Review consent and current campaign state first.

api-reference/voice-campaigns/post-calls.title: Record voice consent
api-reference/voice-campaigns/post-calls.description: Record consent or withdrawal for the current Nixflex voice campaign policy revision. Review the audience and policy before confirming.

api-reference/voice-campaigns/delete.title: Delete a voice campaign
api-reference/voice-campaigns/delete.description: Delete an owned voice campaign, stop waiting work and running calls, and keep sent history and used charges.

api-reference/sms/send.title: Send an SMS
api-reference/sms/send.description: Send one SMS through Nixflex using an explicit, owned sender assigned to the agent. Distinguish acceptance from delivery and handle uncertain results.

api-reference/sms/campaigns-list.title: List SMS campaigns
api-reference/sms/campaigns-list.description: List the account's Nixflex SMS campaigns, newest first. Delivery totals cover all campaign recipients, beyond the current recipient page.

api-reference/sms/campaigns-create.title: Create an SMS campaign
api-reference/sms/campaigns-create.description: Create a Nixflex SMS campaign and its recipients. Default now mode requests launch immediately; use schedule mode to prepare a later launch.

api-reference/sms/campaigns-get.title: Get an SMS campaign
api-reference/sms/campaigns-get.description: Read one owned SMS campaign with recipient and message history. The campaign counters cover the whole campaign; the two history lists have independent cursors.

api-reference/sms-campaigns/patch-sms-ca.title: Update SMS reply settings
api-reference/sms-campaigns/patch-sms-ca.description: Update reply behaviour for an owned Nixflex SMS campaign. This request does not edit the campaign's recipients, schedule or outbound message.

api-reference/sms/campaigns-launch.title: Launch an SMS campaign
api-reference/sms/campaigns-launch.description: Request the first launch of an owned Nixflex SMS campaign. Check readiness, consent and launch state before dispatching messages.

api-reference/sms-campaigns/post-sms-cam.title: Cancel SMS campaign
api-reference/sms-campaigns/post-sms-cam.description: Cancel future work for an owned SMS campaign. Calls or messages already in progress may finish.

api-reference/sms-campaigns/post-sms-cam.title: Resume SMS campaign
api-reference/sms-campaigns/post-sms-cam.description: Resume a bounded page of verified, unattempted recipients in a running Nixflex SMS campaign. This can dispatch messages after policy checks.

api-reference/sms-campaigns/post-sms-cam.title: Record SMS consent
api-reference/sms-campaigns/post-sms-cam.description: Record consent or withdrawal for the current Nixflex SMS campaign policy revision. Review the audience and policy before confirming.

api-reference/sms/campaigns-delete.title: Delete an SMS campaign
api-reference/sms/campaigns-delete.description: Delete an owned SMS campaign, stop waiting work and running calls, and keep sent history and used charges.

api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ca.title: Get knowledge capabilities
api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ca.description: Read knowledge limits, defaults and the account scope marker before enabling import, review and testing controls in your app.

api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ta.title: List knowledge agents
api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ta.description: List active owned agents and their live knowledge state, then use the returned agent IDs for scoped knowledge operations.

api-reference/knowledge/get-agents-targe.title: Get agent knowledge
api-reference/knowledge/get-agents-targe.description: Read an agent’s own knowledge base, settings and current revision. Keep a missing base distinct from an unavailable read.

api-reference/knowledge/put-agents-targe.title: Set agent knowledge
api-reference/knowledge/put-agents-targe.description: Create an agent’s knowledge base or update its settings with the current revision. Saving settings does not publish source text.

api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ba.title: Get knowledge base
api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ba.description: Read knowledge settings, revision and the active published index. Use the current revision when preparing a guarded edit.

api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ba.title: Get knowledge overview
api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ba.description: Read knowledge topic, token, publication and review totals, plus seven-day observations, without inferring publication from a source count.

api-reference/knowledge/get-agents-targe.title: Read automatic keyterms
api-reference/knowledge/get-agents-targe.description: Read ranked automatic speech terms from live agent knowledge, with configured limits and saved manual terms for comparison.

api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-us.title: Get knowledge usage
api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-us.description: Read private knowledge storage inventory and compatibility allowance counters. These values are not a complete billing ledger.

api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ev.title: Read knowledge events
api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ev.description: Read ordered knowledge events for the owning account. Keep the documented paging and filters while reconciling changes.

api-reference/knowledge/post-agents-targ.title: Measure knowledge source
api-reference/knowledge/post-agents-targ.description: Measure source token usage before import without storing or publishing the source. The preview does not reserve later quota.

api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-b.title: Import knowledge source
api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-b.description: Import pasted text or a supported raw file and track preparation. Review flags can require approval before publication.

api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ba.title: List knowledge sources
api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ba.description: List accepted sources with unsuppressed live pieces. Use their saved source IDs for renaming, replacement and deletion.

api-reference/knowledge/patch-knowledge-.title: Rename knowledge source
api-reference/knowledge/patch-knowledge-.description: Rename a saved knowledge source without changing its facts or published index. Confirm the exact source and revision first.

api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-b.title: Replace knowledge source
api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-b.description: Prepare replacement source text while keeping the accepted version available until the reviewed replacement is published.

api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-b.title: Refresh website sources
api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-b.description: Refresh selected saved website sources and follow the resulting job. New website content can still require review.

api-reference/knowledge/delete-knowledge.title: Delete knowledge source
api-reference/knowledge/delete-knowledge.description: Remove an accepted knowledge source with explicit affected-topic confirmation and revision checks, then follow its result.

api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-b.title: Discover website pages
api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-b.description: Discover selectable public website pages without importing or publishing them. Use the returned page IDs for a later selection.

api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-b.title: Import selected pages
api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-b.description: Import selected page IDs from a completed owned website discovery, then follow preparation and any required review.

api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ba.title: Get knowledge draft
api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ba.description: Read proposed knowledge pieces, flags, reminders and the draft revision before editing or approving the selected content.

api-reference/knowledge/patch-knowledge-.title: Edit knowledge draft
api-reference/knowledge/patch-knowledge-.description: Edit a proposed knowledge piece while preserving evidence and review requirements. Resolve revision conflicts before saving.

api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-b.title: Accept knowledge draft
api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-b.description: Approve selected reviewed knowledge pieces and queue publication. Follow the job before claiming the new answers are live.

api-reference/knowledge/delete-knowledge.title: Discard knowledge draft
api-reference/knowledge/delete-knowledge.description: Discard a knowledge review draft while retaining the currently published knowledge. Confirm the intended draft before removal.

api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ba.title: List knowledge topics
api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ba.description: List current knowledge pieces in stable display order and retain the returned topic identities when opening or editing a piece.

api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ba.title: Get knowledge topic
api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ba.description: Read one current knowledge piece, its evidence and saved metadata before preparing a revision-guarded edit.

api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-b.title: Create knowledge topic
api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-b.description: Create a manually written knowledge piece and prepare a fresh index. Check the resulting job before claiming publication.

api-reference/knowledge/patch-knowledge-.title: Update knowledge topic
api-reference/knowledge/patch-knowledge-.description: Correct a live knowledge piece with its current revision and prepare a replacement index without silently overwriting newer work.

api-reference/knowledge/delete-knowledge.title: Delete knowledge topic
api-reference/knowledge/delete-knowledge.description: Remove a current knowledge piece and prevent a source refresh from restoring it. Confirm the revision and track the returned work.

api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-b.title: Search knowledge topics
api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-b.description: Find related current topics in one knowledge base for management. Search results do not predict an agent’s answer on a real call.

api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ba.title: List unanswered questions
api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ba.description: Read recent real questions without a retrieval match. Review the question before turning it into a trusted knowledge answer.

api-reference/knowledge/patch-knowledge-.title: Update knowledge settings
api-reference/knowledge/patch-knowledge-.description: Update knowledge channels, matching mode or the not-found sentence, using the required guards and preserving omitted settings.

api-reference/knowledge/post-agents-targ.title: Start knowledge test
api-reference/knowledge/post-agents-targ.description: Start a knowledge-only simulated session for an agent with live knowledge. This does not place a real telephone call.

api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-te.title: Get knowledge test session
api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-te.description: Read the saved knowledge-test conversation and current session state. Missing answers and failed reads remain unconfirmed.

api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-t.title: Ask a knowledge test question
api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-t.description: Ask a simulated knowledge question and inspect its supplied-piece evidence. Keep one operation identity for the intended message.

api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-t.title: Cancel knowledge test
api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-t.description: Cancel a simulated knowledge session and related unfinished work. Cancellation does not undo work already performed.

api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-jo.title: Get knowledge job
api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-jo.description: Read knowledge job state, progress, result and safe failure details. Interpret readiness using the job kind and result.

api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-j.title: Retry knowledge job
api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-j.description: Retry a failed knowledge job only when its revision and attempt limit permit it. Review the recorded cause first.

api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-j.title: Cancel knowledge job
api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-j.description: Cancel unfinished knowledge work before installation while keeping published knowledge and work already performed.

api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-b.title: Create knowledge export
api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-b.description: Queue a private export of accepted knowledge and settings, then wait for readiness before requesting the download.

api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ex.title: Download knowledge export
api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-ex.description: Download a ready private knowledge export as structured JSON or readable text through the authenticated export route.

api-reference/knowledge/delete-agents-ta.title: Delete agent knowledge
api-reference/knowledge/delete-agents-ta.description: Revoke an agent’s live knowledge and queue private-data deletion. Follow the job and remaining-object count to confirm cleanup.

api-reference/web-agent/get-agent-web-nu.title: Read web agent settings
api-reference/web-agent/get-agent-web-nu.description: Read website agent settings for one owned number, including its current revision and optional appearance configuration.

api-reference/web-agent/patch-agent-web-.title: Update web agent settings
api-reference/web-agent/patch-agent-web-.description: Update website agent settings for one owned number using its current revision. A stale revision is refused so another editor’s change is preserved.

api-reference/agent-inbox/get-agent-inbo.title: Check inbox availability
api-reference/agent-inbox/get-agent-inbo.description: Check whether the Nixflex agent inbox is enabled in this environment. The feature check remains available when other inbox operations are disabled.

api-reference/agent-inbox/get-agent-inbo.title: List inbox numbers
api-reference/agent-inbox/get-agent-inbo.description: List owned numbers available to the Nixflex inbox and their active agent labels. Pending number imports are excluded from the list.

api-reference/agent-inbox/get-agent-inbo.title: List inbox conversations
api-reference/agent-inbox/get-agent-inbo.description: List conversations for one owned number and channel. Read-only listing does not mark messages as read.

api-reference/agent-inbox/get-agent-inbo.title: Read an inbox thread
api-reference/agent-inbox/get-agent-inbo.description: Read retained messages in one owned Nixflex inbox thread. The newest page is selected first, with its messages returned in chronological order.

api-reference/agent-inbox/patch-agent-in.title: Update an inbox thread
api-reference/agent-inbox/patch-agent-in.description: Update a Nixflex inbox thread's archive state or acknowledge messages through a known read version. Listing messages alone does not mark them read.

api-reference/agent-inbox/get-agent-inbo.title: Read inbox retention
api-reference/agent-inbox/get-agent-inbo.description: Read the Nixflex account retention default and inbox cleanup availability. Include a number to resolve retention for its assigned agent.

api-reference/caller-context/delete.title: Delete caller context
api-reference/caller-context/delete.description: Delete the complete Nixflex caller-context record for one caller on an owned business number. Review the record's scope before removing it.

api-reference/caller-context/get.title: Get caller context
api-reference/caller-context/get.description: Read saved Nixflex caller context for one caller and owned business number. Handle a missing record without inventing previous caller details.

api-reference/caller-context/set.title: Set caller context
api-reference/caller-context/set.description: Set supplied Nixflex caller context for one caller on an owned business number. Review saved-field behaviour and the response before retrying.

api-reference/caller-context/import.title: Import caller context
api-reference/caller-context/import.description: Import caller context for an owned Nixflex business number. Each row merges supplied customer context into the caller's existing record.

api-reference/contact-controls/post-cont.title: Preview contact hours
api-reference/contact-controls/post-cont.description: Preview recipient-local Nixflex contact windows without sending calls or SMS. Treat the result as advisory and recheck policy at dispatch.

api-reference/contact-controls/get-conta.title: List contact suppressions
api-reference/contact-controls/get-conta.description: List stored Nixflex do-not-contact entries in a channel bucket. Understand the all-channel bucket and how it differs from a combined list.

api-reference/contact-controls/post-cont.title: Add contact suppressions
api-reference/contact-controls/post-cont.description: Add Nixflex do-not-contact entries for future contact checks. Existing entries are retained; review the number, channel and suppression reason.

api-reference/contact-controls/delete-co.title: Remove a contact suppression
api-reference/contact-controls/delete-co.description: Remove one explicitly removable, owner-created Nixflex suppression. Recipient opt-outs and entries without removal permission remain protected.

api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.title: Get Cal.com settings
api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.description: Read the saved Cal.com settings for an owned phone number. Secret values are represented by configuration flags.

api-reference/integration-settings/put-i.title: Set Cal.com settings
api-reference/integration-settings/put-i.description: Replace Cal.com settings for one owned number. Omitted configuration values do not retain the previous saved values.

api-reference/integration-settings/delet.title: Delete Cal.com settings
api-reference/integration-settings/delet.description: Remove saved Cal.com settings for an owned Nixflex number. This clears the integration configuration without disconnecting the phone number.

api-reference/integration-settings/googl.title: Connect Google Calendar
api-reference/integration-settings/googl.description: Connect Google Calendar to an owned Nixflex number. Create a consent link, handle return codes and keep OAuth credentials private.

api-reference/integration-settings/googl.title: Get Google Calendar status
api-reference/integration-settings/googl.description: Read the Google Calendar connection for an owned Nixflex number, including reconnect state and whether caller invitations are enabled.

api-reference/integration-settings/googl.title: Disconnect Google Calendar
api-reference/integration-settings/googl.description: Disconnect Google Calendar from an owned Nixflex number. Remove local access and understand in-flight bookings and shared Google grants.

api-reference/integration-settings/googl.title: Update Google Calendar settings
api-reference/integration-settings/googl.description: Set calendar timezone, weekly hours, slot length and caller invitations for an owned Nixflex number. Omitted settings retain their saved value.

api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.title: Get Slack settings
api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.description: Read the saved Slack settings for an owned phone number. Secret values are represented by configuration flags.

api-reference/integration-settings/put-i.title: Set Slack settings
api-reference/integration-settings/put-i.description: Replace saved Slack settings for an owned Nixflex number. Supply the complete intended configuration and review omitted-field behaviour.

api-reference/integration-settings/delet.title: Delete Slack settings
api-reference/integration-settings/delet.description: Remove saved Slack settings for an owned Nixflex number. This clears the integration configuration without disconnecting the phone number.

api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.title: Get Zapier settings
api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.description: Read the saved Zapier settings for an owned phone number. Secret values are represented by configuration flags.

api-reference/integration-settings/put-i.title: Set Zapier settings
api-reference/integration-settings/put-i.description: Replace Zapier settings for one owned number, then read back the destination. Saving it does not prove event delivery.

api-reference/integration-settings/delet.title: Delete Zapier settings
api-reference/integration-settings/delet.description: Remove saved Zapier settings for an owned Nixflex number. This clears the integration configuration without disconnecting the phone number.

api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.title: Get Make settings
api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.description: Read the saved Make settings for an owned phone number. Secret values are represented by configuration flags.

api-reference/integration-settings/put-i.title: Set Make settings
api-reference/integration-settings/put-i.description: Replace saved Make settings for an owned Nixflex number. Supply the complete intended configuration and review omitted-field behaviour.

api-reference/integration-settings/delet.title: Delete Make settings
api-reference/integration-settings/delet.description: Remove the saved Make configuration scoped to this account and number. This does not disconnect the phone number. A missing configuration also returns success.

api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.title: Get GoHighLevel settings
api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.description: Read saved GoHighLevel settings for an owned Nixflex number. Configuration flags indicate secret presence without returning secret values.

api-reference/integration-settings/put-i.title: Set GoHighLevel settings
api-reference/integration-settings/put-i.description: Replace saved GoHighLevel settings for an owned Nixflex number. Supply the complete intended configuration for this integration.

api-reference/integration-settings/delet.title: Delete GoHighLevel settings
api-reference/integration-settings/delet.description: Remove saved GoHighLevel settings for an owned Nixflex number. This clears the integration configuration without disconnecting the phone number.

api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.title: Get pre-call gate for number
api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.description: Read the pre-call gate for an owned Nixflex number. A saved number-specific gate overrides the default from its assigned agent.

api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.title: Get pre-call gate for agent
api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.description: Read an owned Nixflex agent's default pre-call gate. Number-specific settings can override this default for individual numbers.

api-reference/integration-settings/put-i.title: Set pre-call gate for number
api-reference/integration-settings/put-i.description: Set the pre-call gate setting for an owned number. A number-specific gate overrides its agent default. Clearing it restores the agent default when one exists.

api-reference/integration-settings/put-i.title: Set pre-call gate for agent
api-reference/integration-settings/put-i.description: Set an owned Nixflex agent's default pre-call gate. Number-specific settings can override this default for individual numbers.

api-reference/integration-settings/delet.title: Clear pre-call gate for number
api-reference/integration-settings/delet.description: Clear a saved number-specific Nixflex pre-call gate. Review the assigned agent's default when deciding the number's resulting gate behaviour.

api-reference/integration-settings/delet.title: Clear pre-call gate for agent
api-reference/integration-settings/delet.description: Clear the saved pre-call gate setting for an owned agent. This is the default for numbers on the agent; a number-specific gate takes precedence.

api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.title: List custom functions
api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.description: List up to 15 saved custom functions for an owned Nixflex number. An empty list means no matching functions are saved for that account and number.

api-reference/integration-settings/post-.title: Create a custom function
api-reference/integration-settings/post-.description: Create a custom function for an owned Nixflex number. Each number allows up to 15 functions with names unique within that number.

api-reference/integration-settings/patch.title: Update a custom function
api-reference/integration-settings/patch.description: Update selected fields of a custom function for an owned Nixflex number. Omitted fields keep their saved values.

api-reference/integration-settings/delet.title: Delete a custom function
api-reference/integration-settings/delet.description: Delete one custom function by its account, Nixflex number and function ID. Review the response and missing-function behaviour before retrying.

api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.title: Get first webhook
api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.description: Read the primary webhook setting for an owned Nixflex number. Primary and secondary slots are configured independently.

api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.title: Get second webhook
api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.description: Read the secondary webhook setting for an owned Nixflex number. Secondary and primary slots are configured independently.

api-reference/integration-settings/put-i.title: Set first webhook
api-reference/integration-settings/put-i.description: Set the primary webhook for an owned Nixflex number. Review event contracts, signature verification and duplicate delivery handling.

api-reference/integration-settings/put-i.title: Set second webhook
api-reference/integration-settings/put-i.description: Set the secondary webhook for an owned Nixflex number. Review event contracts, signature verification and duplicate delivery handling.

api-reference/integration-settings/delet.title: Clear first webhook
api-reference/integration-settings/delet.description: Clear the primary webhook setting for an owned Nixflex number. This request targets the primary slot independently of the secondary slot.

api-reference/integration-settings/delet.title: Clear second webhook
api-reference/integration-settings/delet.description: Clear the secondary webhook setting for an owned Nixflex number. This request targets the secondary slot independently of the primary slot.

api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.title: Get web calls
api-reference/integration-settings/get-i.description: Read the website voice-call switch for an owned number. Reading the saved setting does not start or prove a browser call.

api-reference/integration-settings/put-i.title: Set web calls
api-reference/integration-settings/put-i.description: Set the website voice-call switch for an owned Nixflex number. Review its saved state without starting a web call.

api-reference/integration-settings/delet.title: Clear web calls
api-reference/integration-settings/delet.description: Clear the website voice-call switch for an owned number. This changes configuration without starting a browser call.

api-reference/organisation/roles.title: Check organisation roles and permissions
api-reference/organisation/roles.description: Compare Owner, Admin and Member permissions in Nixflex. Keep server-side API key authority separate from personal dashboard sessions and membership checks.

api-reference/organisation/get-organisat.title: Get organisation context
api-reference/organisation/get-organisat.description: Read the Nixflex organisation selected by the authenticated credential, including its current permissions and account context.

api-reference/organisation/get-organisat.title: List organisation members
api-reference/organisation/get-organisat.description: List Nixflex organisation members, up to 100 pending or expired invitations, and current safety limits. Review role permissions before changes.

api-reference/organisation/get-organisat.title: List organisation activity
api-reference/organisation/get-organisat.description: Read Nixflex organisation activity, newest first, with up to 50 events per JSON page. Check role permissions and paging rules.

api-reference/organisation/post-organisa.title: Request an owner claim
api-reference/organisation/post-organisa.description: Invite a verified recipient to claim an existing, unclaimed Nixflex API-only account. Sending the invitation does not complete the claim.

api-reference/organisation/post-organisa.title: Invite a teammate
api-reference/organisation/post-organisa.description: Send a 24-hour Nixflex team invitation. The recipient must accept using their own verified login; opening the email does not add membership.

api-reference/organisation/post-organisa.title: Resend a team invitation
api-reference/organisation/post-organisa.description: Replace a Nixflex team invitation with a new ID and 24-hour link. The previous link becomes invalid and sending limits still apply.

api-reference/organisation/delete-organi.title: Revoke a team invitation
api-reference/organisation/delete-organi.description: Revoke a pending or expired Nixflex invitation before acceptance. The link becomes invalid; this does not remove an existing team member.

api-reference/organisation/patch-organis.title: Change an organisation role
api-reference/organisation/patch-organis.description: Change a non-Owner Nixflex member to Admin or Member using Owner authority. Review the resulting permissions before saving the role.

api-reference/organisation/delete-organi.title: Remove an organisation member
api-reference/organisation/delete-organi.description: Remove one non-Owner member from a Nixflex organisation. Shared work and the shared API key remain; review any separate access that also needs removal.

api-reference/organisation/patch-organis.title: Rename an organisation
api-reference/organisation/patch-organis.description: Rename a Nixflex organisation using its API key or the Owner's personal session. Set the business name shown for that organisation.

api-reference/organisation/get-organisat.title: Get the signing secret
api-reference/organisation/get-organisat.description: Privately retrieve the Nixflex organisation signing secret to verify event deliveries. Keep it server-side and out of logs, browsers and shared output.

api-reference/account/create-key.title: Create an API account
api-reference/account/create-key.description: Create a separate Nixflex API-only account and its credential. This does not add another key to an existing account.

api-reference/account/rotate-key.title: Rotate the API key
api-reference/account/rotate-key.description: Rotate the Nixflex account's API secret immediately while keeping its key ID. Plan the change because the old secret stops working.

api-reference/account/usage.title: Get account usage
api-reference/account/usage.description: Read Nixflex account usage and call-capacity information. Occupancy can include unresolved reservations as well as active calls.

api-reference/account-and-keys/get-accou.title: Get account retention
api-reference/account-and-keys/get-accou.description: Read the Nixflex account retention default for new agents. Existing agents retain their saved settings until explicitly updated.

api-reference/account-and-keys/get-keys-.title: Get key activity
api-reference/account-and-keys/get-keys-.description: Read a snapshot of retained Nixflex API request activity for the account. Distinguish request logs from call history and billing usage.

api-reference/voices/get-voices.title: List voices
api-reference/voices/get-voices.description: List voices visible to the Nixflex account. Check compatibility for the optional agent context before choosing a voice.

api-reference/voices/get-voices-voice_ke.title: Get a voice
api-reference/voices/get-voices-voice_ke.description: Read a voice visible to the Nixflex account and its compatibility with an optional agent language. A successful read does not guarantee compatibility.

sdks/ecosystem.title: Choose an API client or developer tool
sdks/ecosystem.description: Compare Node, Python, CLI and MCP, install the published packages and choose HTTP when a client does not expose the method you need.

sdks/node.title: Use the Node SDK in a server application
sdks/node.description: Install the Node SDK, make a safe read, persist outbound call intent and reconcile typed results without automatic mutation retries.

sdks/python.title: Use the Python SDK with sync or async code
sdks/python.description: Install the Python SDK, manage sync and async clients, save outbound request IDs and preserve unknown write and booking states.

sdks/other-languages.title: Call the API from another language
sdks/other-languages.description: Use direct HTTPS with private bearer credentials, bounded reads and schema-aware error handling, then verify generated clients against the public contract.

cli/overview.title: Use the CLI with a private account connection
cli/overview.description: Install the reviewed CLI, choose the account and API host explicitly, understand private input and distinguish read retries from deliberate writes.

cli/quickstart.title: Make a safe CLI read and prepare a call
cli/quickstart.description: Verify the CLI account connection with a usage read, prepare an outbound UUID locally and keep any approved send separate from read-only recovery.

cli/commands.title: Find the CLI command for your task
cli/commands.description: Find reviewed CLI command families, exact call recovery commands, private credential inputs and confirmation boundaries before running a change.

sdks/mcp.title: Build approved workflows with MCP tools
sdks/mcp.description: Use the reviewed MCP tool inventory, prepare outbound calls without sending and reconcile saved request and booking states while keeping credentials private.

ai-tools/overview.title: Connect an AI assistant to your Nixflex account
ai-tools/overview.description: Choose a local AI client for the Nixflex MCP server, verify its 97 tools and understand approvals, private credentials and call-result limits.

ai-tools/claude.title: Connect Claude Desktop or Claude Code to Nixflex
ai-tools/claude.description: Set up the Nixflex MCP server in Claude Desktop or Code, verify a safe read and try five prompts for agents, knowledge, calls, calendars and usage.

ai-tools/cursor.title: Connect Cursor to Nixflex with MCP
ai-tools/cursor.description: Connect Cursor to the Nixflex MCP server using private environment variables, verify the tools and try five prompts with clear approval and action limits.

ai-tools/codex.title: Connect Codex to Nixflex with MCP
ai-tools/codex.description: Configure the Nixflex MCP server in Codex without saving a key in TOML. Verify a read and try five prompts for agents, knowledge, calls, booking and usage.

ai-tools/chatgpt.title: Use ChatGPT to plan and review Nixflex work
ai-tools/chatgpt.description: Use Nixflex docs in ChatGPT, compare hosted MCP and an admin-managed tunnel, and try five prompts with clear setup and account-action limits.

ai-tools/calendar-settings.title: Manage Google Calendar with your AI assistant
ai-tools/calendar-settings.description: Use the MCP server’s calendar tools for human consent, status, settings and disconnection while keeping booking and email-delivery limits clear.

ai-tools/number-credentials.title: Update number credentials through private setup
ai-tools/number-credentials.description: Prepare private carrier credentials for the MCP server’s number-update tool and handle confirmation, missing setup and uncertain routing results.

ai-tools/call-results.title: Check call requests and booking results with AI
ai-tools/call-results.description: Use the MCP server’s read tools to inspect saved call requests and retained booking results without redialling or inventing missing outcomes.

guides/business/dashboard.title: Read your dashboard overview
guides/business/dashboard.description: Review call trends, outcomes and recent activity in the Nixflex dashboard, then open the right call, billing or status view for details.

guides/business/api-keys.title: Manage your organisation API key
guides/business/api-keys.description: Find the full organisation key, check its activity and limits, and rotate it carefully without sharing credentials in browser code or AI chats.

api-reference/voice-campaigns/get.title: Get a voice campaign
api-reference/voice-campaigns/get.description: Read one owned voice campaign, its saved schedule and current progress. Check wider-hours confirmation without retrieving recipients.
